sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description:
Retrieves relevant campus food-service Knowledge articles for the current Food Base Problem.
The search must prioritize the exact Use Case and problem context from the current Food Base Problem.
Match Knowledge articles using: - Use Case - Problem Type - Meal Type - Mess Hall - Description
For Allergy Management Request, prioritize Knowledge related to allergy management, allergen handling, allergic reactions, and dietary allergy safety.
Do not return Knowledge articles that are unrelated to the current Use Case.
Do not use Knowledge articles to determine Priority.
Return only actual Knowledge articles from the configured Knowledge source. Do not return Food Base Problem records or other non-Knowledge records.
sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.inputs: [{"name":"search_type","description":"Search type","value":"keyword"},{"name":"query","description":"search query for retrieving relevant information from Knowledge Table"},{"name":"search_profile","value":"sn_aia_ai_agents_agent_search","label":"[AI Agents] - Agent Search","description":"Search profile"},{"name":"sources","label":["Knowledge Table"],"value":["kb_knowledge"],"description":"Search sources"},{"name":"fields","label":["Number [kb_knowledge]","Short description [kb_knowledge]","Article body [kb_knowledge]"],"value":["kb_knowledge.number","kb_knowledge.short_description","kb_knowledge.text"],"description":"Fields to be returned"},{"name":"search_results_limit","value":"5","description":"Search results limit"},{"name":"semantic_index_names","label":["body","title"],"value":["body","title"],"description":"Semantic indexed fields"},{"name":"document_match_threshold","value":"00.85","description":"Document matching threshold"}]
sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.name: Find Food Knowledge
sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.transformation_instructions:
Return only relevant Knowledge article information as source data for the AI Agent.
For each relevant article, return only: - Number - Short description - Article body
Select only articles relevant to the current Food Base Problem.
Prioritize articles that match the: - Use Case - Problem Type - Meal Type - Mess Hall - Description
Do not return: - Resolution Steps - Sources - URLs - citations - unrelated articles - recommendations - additional explanations
Do not determine or modify Priority from Knowledge articles.
Do not generate recommended_action in this tool. The AI Agent must use the relevant Knowledge information together with the Food Base Problem details to generate the final recommended_action.
